description.value: Pho Den is a Vietnamese restaurant situated in a unit along Kingsway in Burnaby, one of the Lower Mainland's busiest arterial corridors. It offers indoor dining and online ordering, making it a convenient stop for cyclists riding the Kingsway corridor. The restaurant's pho-focused menu provides a hot, restorative meal option for touring cyclists passing through the Burnaby–Vancouver urban stretch.
